messages:
jordan_cs: Incoming model onboarding request from Northpoint Retail. They want an order-item-to-SKU normalizer + category tagger. No PHI but lots of PII-like customer names in logs they plan to strip. Asking for help with safety checks and rollout plan.

marta_engineering: Thanks Jordan. Can they share a sanitized sample (CSV, 200 rows) and a short spec of allowed transformations? Need to know edge cases (ambiguous names, merged SKUs). Also what's the renewal timeline?

jordan_cs: Shared drive link dropped. Renewal window in ~8 weeks; customer said slow onboarding may impact upsell discussion. Priority: medium-high.

intake-bot: New intake created: northpoint-normalizer-0316. Intake ID: NP-9032. Priority: medium-high.

devon_sre: Recommend staged rollout: hosted canary -> dedicated pool if traffic spikes. For accuracy target, set NER F1 >= 0.82 and SKU top-1 >= 90%. If latency target <70ms choose 7B quantized; otherwise 13B.

marta_engineering: I'll run a quick eval once we have the CSV. Please include expected failure examples and a small eval rubric (precision/recall thresholds). Also flag any regulatory constraints in their region (EU).

jordan_cs: Customer uploaded CSV and a short rubric doc. They noted ambiguous SKUs in 0.5% of cases and want manual-review fallback for those. Requested enablement call next Wed 9am CET.

devon_sre: Provisioning a staging slot now. ETA ~18h. I'll post endpoint + quick curl example when ready. Also adding rate-limit config for canary.

marta_engineering: I'll scope safety evals: data leakage checks, hallucination tests with adversarial inputs, and a false-positives audit. Goal: preliminary pass by Friday so we can present go/no-go before renewal talks.

jordan_cs: Noted. I'm going to loop in renewals and the account owner to keep them updated. If we hit blockers I'll flag for an accelerated engineering sprint. :triage_flag:
